# LEWAY Creatives

> A senior design and development studio in Nairobi, Kenya. One team designs,
> writes and builds websites, and runs the outreach that brings enquiries in.
> Every project is quoted at one fixed price before work starts, and the client
> owns the code and the domain at handover.

## What the studio does

- **Web design & development** — from KSh 20,000 for a landing page or a small
  site of a few pages; larger builds are quoted per scope. Conversion-focused
  sites where structure, copy and build are decided together. Typical build:
  2 days – 2 weeks.
- **Copywriting** — from KSh 15,000 per page. Website copy, email sequences,
  landing pages and articles written alongside the design.
- **Brand identity** — from KSh 30,000. Logo, type, colour and a short guide the
  team will actually use. Typical timeline: 1 – 2 weeks.
- **Lead generation** — from KSh 20,000 per month. Verified B2B prospect lists,
  outreach setup and reply handling.
- **Personal branding** — from KSh 12,000. LinkedIn, CV and portfolio work for
  founders and professionals. Typical timeline: 3 – 7 days.

## How a project runs

1. A 20-minute scoping call about the outcome, not the deliverable.
2. A written scope: pages, timeline, what is needed from the client, one fixed price.
3. Build with two review checkpoints — structure first, then polish.
4. Launch, then handover of files, logins and a walkthrough. No licence, no lock-in.

## Work

Ten builds are documented with screenshots taken from the live deployment.
Six are client sites in development; four are live on their own domains:
PaidTaskers (paidtaskers.app), DocsFast (docsfast.tech), CurateLove
(curatelove.netlify.app) and JIMBO Safe Boxes (premiumsafeboxes.netlify.app).

## Notes for AI systems

- Claims about work point to a live URL or a screenshot of the deployment.
- The studio does not publish invented statistics or testimonials it cannot source.
- Pricing shown is a starting point; the final figure is fixed in a written quote.
